# Master Software Testing

> A comprehensive QA and software testing resource covering STLC phases, testing techniques, automation frameworks, and practical quality assurance strategies led by expert Parul Dhingra.

Master Software Testing provides in-depth guides on software testing fundamentals, the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), testing methodologies, and test automation with tools like Selenium and TestNG. Founded by Parul Dhingra, a Senior QA professional with 13+ years of test automation expertise, the site offers both educational content and professional QA consulting services.

## Key Topics

- Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
- Quality Assurance (QA)
- Test Automation
- Selenium WebDriver
- TestNG
- Test Planning
- Test Design
- Test Execution
- Boundary Value Analysis
- Equivalence Partitioning
- Risk-Based Testing
- Defect Life Cycle
- Requirements Analysis
- Agile Testing
- Azure DevOps

## Software Testing Fundamentals

- [Master Software Testing: Complete Guide to QA & Testing](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com): Homepage covering STLC phases, testing techniques, automation with Selenium and Playwright.
- [Software Testing 101: What Is Software Testing?](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-101-what-is-software-testing): Comprehensive beginner guide to testing fundamentals, methodologies, and best practices.
- [Testing Fundamentals: Complete Guide to Software Testing Basics](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals): Hub for QA basics covering STLC, black-box/white-box testing, and testing principles.
- [Functional vs Non-Functional Testing: Complete Guide for QA Teams](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/functional-vs-non-functional-testing): Comparison guide for functional and non-functional testing with practical examples.

## Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)

- [Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC): Complete Guide to All Phases](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle): Index covering all STLC phases from requirements analysis to test closure.
- [Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC): Complete Guide to Systematic Quality Assurance](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/stlc-overview): Comprehensive STLC guide covering phases, deliverables, and Agile/Waterfall implementation.
- [Requirements Analysis in Software Testing: Complete STLC Phase Guide](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/requirements-analysis): Guide to requirements analysis covering testability, RTM, and ambiguity detection.
- [Test Planning in Software Testing: Your Complete Implementation Guide](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/test-planning): Expert strategies for test planning with IEEE 829 guidance and resource allocation.
- [Test Design in Software Testing: The Complete Guide to Building Effective Test Cases](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/test-design): Guide to test design techniques covering boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning.
- [Test Execution Phase in STLC: The Complete Practical Guide](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/test-execution): Practical strategies for test execution covering defect tracking and DevOps integration.

## Test Design & Strategy Techniques

- [Boundary Value Analysis: Complete Guide to BVA Testing](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/boundary-value-analysis): Guide to boundary value analysis with practical examples and equivalence partitioning.
- [Equivalence Partitioning: Complete Guide to EP Testing](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/equivalence-partitioning): Master equivalence partitioning with examples and integration with boundary value analysis.
- [Risk-Based Testing: Practical Guide to Prioritizing Your Testing Efforts](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/risk-based-testing): Guide to risk-based testing with risk matrices and prioritization techniques.
- [Defect Life Cycle: Complete Guide to Bug Tracking and Resolution](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/defect-life-cycle): Practical guide covering defect states, severity vs priority, and bug report writing.

## Requirements & Test Planning

- [How to Master Test Requirement Analysis: A Practical Guide](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/requirements-analysis/master-test-requirement-analysis): Practical techniques for requirement analysis, RTM building, and test coverage improvement.
- [How to Create a Test Plan: Complete Step-by-Step Guide](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/test-planning/how-to-create-a-test-plan): Step-by-step guide to test plan creation with IEEE 829 standards and templates.
- [Tips and Tricks for Requirement Analysis: Practical Guide for Testing Teams](https://mastersoftwaretesting.com/testing-fundamentals/software-testing-life-cycle/requirements-analysis/tips-and-tricks-on-requirement-analysis): Practical tips for requirement analysis including gap identification and RTM techniques.
